name: Mikage Shizuku
source:
[url=/c10396]Nana's[/url] best friend and classmate who is a member of the broadcasting committee. She is extremely shy and has even trouble shopping unless Nana is with her. To Shizuku, Nana is "small but very reliable", and the two are almost always seen together. Due to her kind personality and beautiful appearance, Shizuku is popular with the boys.

Shizuku is a bit of a sheltered girl and panics easily. Just in case, she carries around a crime prevention buzzer which she almost always takes out and presses when she is about to have or has a panic attack. When it comes to the topic of love and ideal types, she would want a man who is not only handsome but also has a strong personality.

[Translated from the [url=http://products.web-giga.com/hotchkiss/heroine.html]official website[/url]]
